description: This file contains the implementation of the Free shipping model for the OpenCart platform, defining the getQuote method, which determines if free shipping is available based on geo zone and subtotal conditions.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: A model class extending OpenCart's base Model class, responsible for calculating free shipping availability.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns the free shipping quote if conditions are met based on geo zone and subtotal.
